id.description: Stripe payment method ID. Pass this as `payment_method_id` when creating a cluster.

type.description: Payment method type. Only `card` is currently supported.

last4.description: Last four digits of the card number.

is_default.description: Whether this is the customer's default payment method for future invoices.

in_use_by_active_subscription.description: Whether an active subscription is currently billed to this payment method. Such a payment method cannot be removed until the subscription is moved to another card.

in_use_by.description: Names of the clusters whose active subscription is billed to this payment method. May be empty even when in_use_by_active_subscription is true, if the subscription isn't tied to a cluster.
